'''Varus Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[House of Thul|House Thul]] allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He guided the Thul troops in the conquest of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] stronghold of [[Fort Orrus]] alongside the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Serrok]] and like him was later defeated by a Republic spacer who reclaimed the fort.
